verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows WooCommerce's core commerce features (payments, shipping, REST API, extensions marketplace) but contains no mention of any built-in or officially documented capability to list/sync products to external marketplaces, social commerce channels, or shopping feeds from one catalog. Multi-channel sync is a fair question for an ecommerce platform, but nothing in the pack demonstrates it — only generic 'hundreds of extensions' claims without naming any channel-sync integration.
